interpretation: Four sectors show slightly unequal V-shaped dips with flat shoulders. The median depths are 41.3 and 37.6 ppt. Both eclipse images favor the target in both checked sectors. Gaia measured a separate 281-day astrometric orbit. The components of the short-period pair are unresolved.
prior_evidence: Earlier public TESS-SPOC full-frame threshold-crossing events. Unvetted Kostov et al. Table 2 machine flag. Gaia DR3 Orbital orbit at 281.1083 days
